snippet.title: Super Drill Panic
snippet.description:
An adventurous game based on a simple and classic gameplay. Every level adds new traps and challenges as you try and escape down the temples, buildings and caves.  Avoid spiders, pilars, shooting statues, falling debri and more in this frantic little arcade game

In Orangepixel's great pixelated retro style, this game is available on Android, read more at the game blog:

http://orangepixel.net/drillpanic
